description: This file contains the abstract base class 'EntityOperator' which defines various types of entity comparison and join operators used within the Apache OFBiz framework for building dynamic database queries. It includes operator registration, lookup methods, and abstract methods for evaluating and generating SQL conditions.

classes.name: EntityOperator
classes.description: An abstract class representing various comparison and join operators applicable to entity queries in OFBiz. It supports registration, lookup, comparison, and SQL generation for operators like '=', '<', 'IN', 'BETWEEN', 'AND', 'OR', 'LIKE', etc.

classes.name: EntityOperator.CollectionEntityComparisonOperator
classes.description: A nested static class for handling comparison operators where the right-hand side is a collection, e.g., IN and BETWEEN.

classes.name: EntityOperator.ComparableEntityComparisonOperator
classes.description: A nested static class for comparison operators where the comparison is performed between comparable elements, e.g., '=', '<', '>'.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers an operator name with an EntityOperator instance, handling case insensitivity and variant strings.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Retrieves a registered EntityOperator by name.

methods.name: lookupComparison
methods.description: Looks up and returns an EntityComparisonOperator by name, throwing an exception if not a comparison operator.

methods.name: lookupJoin
methods.description: Looks up and returns an EntityJoinOperator by name, throwing an exception if not a join operator.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Checks if a given entity matches a comparison with provided lhs and rhs.

methods.name: appendRHSList
methods.description: Appends a list or collection of values to the SQL where clause, with proper formatting.

methods.name: appendRHSBetweenList
methods.description: Appends a BETWEEN list to the where clause, combining elements with AND.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if a comparison with given lhs and rhs is considered empty.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Abstract method to evaluate if a map of fields matches the condition with lhs and rhs.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Abstract method to validate SQL correctness for the operator with given entity, lhs, and rhs.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Abstract method to add the operator's value to an SQL statement.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Creates an immutable representation of the condition for later evaluation or SQL generation.
